query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.permission
         FROM role_grants g
         JOIN role_permissions p ON p.role_id = g.role_id
         WHERE g.actor_id = $1
           AND (g.scope_kind = 'platform'
                OR (g.scope_kind = 'workspace' AND g.scope_id = $2)
                OR (g.scope_kind = 'project' AND g.scope_id = $3))
